stories.title: Mirra Andreeva holds nerve against Svitolina to win WTA Finals for first time
summary: Andreeva seals 7-5, 6-3 victory to earn world No 2 rankingRussian dominates tournament without losing a setMirra Andreeva had put herself on the brink of securing another effortless, straightforward set in one of the biggest finals of her career when she momentarily balked.
This time, she betrayed no negative emotions at all.
Andreeva immediately retrieved the break and regained her momentum as she marched to a monumental victory, defeating Elina Svitolina 7-5, 6-3 to win the WTA Finals at Indian Wells for the first time.
